description_for_human: Tailor a resume to a specific job opening: ATS keyword scoring, an honest three-bucket gap analysis, and format checks that never fabricate experience or metrics.
description_for_model: Use this plugin when a user wants a resume scored or tailored for a specific job opening. score_resume gives a deterministic ATS readiness score before and after a rewrite. extract_keywords lists what a posting actually names. gap_analysis returns matched and missing keywords — sort missing items into present-but-buried, rephraseable, and genuinely missing; never write genuinely missing items, employers, titles, dates or metrics into a resume. check_format flags ATS parsing risks in a resume on its own.
